_comment: 後台介面的英文。**鍵就是畫面上那一句中文**（admin.html 的 i18n 區塊照這一句去查），所以不必發明 key；中文改了這裡沒跟著改，npm test 會報（scripts/i18n-scan.mjs）。patterns 是帶變數的字串：[正則, 英文]，$1 是括號裡抓到的東西。翻不動的（語言名、人名以外的專有名詞）就照原文放，測試只看有沒有這一條。

strings.這是預覽站：資料跟正式站分開，看不到正式站的參訪: This is the preview site: its data is kept apart from the live site, so visits on the live site do not show up here
strings.這一頁：參訪前把四件事做完: This tab: four things to finish before the visit
strings.——讀來信抽出資料、確認欄位、查對方背景、排今日流程。做完就有一個來賓專頁可以給: — read the email and pull out the details, check the fields, look up who they are, plan the programme for the day. When that is done you have a guest page to hand over. Everything saves itself; there is no save button.
strings.貼上 email 往來或上傳名單檔，AI 抽取背景: Paste the email thread or upload a list; AI pulls out the background
strings.單位、人名、職稱、人數、隨行名單與聯絡方式、對口老師、來訪目的、興趣、日期時間。: Organisation, names, titles, headcount, the accompanying party and their contact details, the host teacher, the purpose of the visit, interests, date and time. What it finds fills in the fields below; read each one and correct it.
strings.名單檔：Word（.docx）、Excel（.xlsx）、CSV／文字、PDF、: List files: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), CSV/text, PDF, a photo of a list — up to 8 files, 5 MB in total; save .doc/.xls in the newer format first
strings.AI 讀出來的一律要你看過。: Everything the AI reads out is yours to check.
strings.名單上每個人的 email 最重要: An email address for every person on the list matters most
strings.——訪後信會寄給名單上每一個人，漏一個就少一份回饋；當場拿不到的可以之後在「收工: — the thank-you letter goes to everyone on the list, and each one missing is one response lost; anyone you cannot get on the day can be added later by photographing their card in Wrap-up.
strings.來賓專頁網址的後半段；寄出信或有人回覆之後就固定了。: The last part of the guest page address; it is fixed once a letter has gone out or someone has replied.
strings.參訪名單（每一個人都要留 email：訪後信會寄給名單上每一個人）: Visitor list (an email for every person: the thank-you letter goes to everyone on the list)
strings.用網路查這個單位與名單上的人的公開專業資料，整理出: Searches the web for public, professional information about the organisation and the people on the list, and writes up
strings.、可能最想看哪幾間、可以先準備什麼。只給主辦端看，不會出現在來賓專頁或信裡。查完: , which laboratories they would most want to see, and what to prepare. For the host only — it never appears on the guest page or in a letter. The result appears below on its own; there is no need to press again.
strings.「今日流程」會印在簡報第 2 頁，也會出現在來賓專頁；「現場動線」決定來賓幾點走: "Programme for today" is printed on slide 2 of the deck and shown on the guest page; "Route" decides which laboratory the visitors are in at what time, and is the baseline for the movement record. Minutes are always recalculated from the defaults (20 min overview, 20 min per laboratory, the rest to the open discussion); change them here if that does not fit.
strings.今日流程（第 2 頁 Programme；固定含總體簡報、研究室參訪、綜合討論）: Programme for today (slide 2; always includes the overview, the laboratory tour and the open discussion)
strings.現場動線（第一站固定是總體介紹，地點預設 302；預設總體介紹 20 分、每間: Route (the first stop is always the overview, in 302 by default; 20 min for the overview, 20 min per laboratory, the rest goes to the open discussion; leave a laboratory at 0 to skip it)
strings.同一個網址的 QR: QR code for the same address
strings.這一場專屬的頁面：當天的流程、五間老師卡片，來賓可以在上面留 email。: This visit's own page: the programme for the day and the five laboratory cards, with a box where guests can leave their email.
strings.QR 是拿來印或投影的: The QR code is for printing or projecting
strings.——放在門口或簡報最後一頁，來賓自己掃就打得開，不必個別傳網址。產生簡報時也會自: — put it by the door or on the last slide and guests open the page themselves; you do not have to send the address to each of them. The generated deck carries the same QR code on a slide of its own.
strings.點一列就叫出來: click a row to open it
strings.排新的一場之前先看一眼：: Worth a look before planning a new one:
strings.同類單位上次怎麼排、選了哪幾頁: how a similar organisation was planned last time, and which slides were chosen
strings.。點開只是切換到那一場，手上這一場不會掉——沒填完的都先暫存著。: . Opening one only switches to that visit; the one in your hands is not lost — anything unfinished is kept.
strings.這一頁：挑這一場要講哪幾頁，產出這一場專屬的 .pptx: This tab: choose what this visit will cover, and generate its own .pptx
strings.——母簡報 72 頁不可能全講，這裡從中挑選並重排，第 1–3 頁（封面、今日流: — all 72 slides of the master deck cannot be covered, so this picks from them and reorders; slides 1–3 (cover, programme, contents) are rewritten for this visit. Some visits are just a conversation: tick "no deck for this visit" and the whole tab switches off.
strings.這場不用簡報，只口頭介紹: No deck for this visit, just talk them through it
strings.勾起來就不挑頁、不產檔。今日流程的總體介紹照常，只是不放投影片。: Ticked, there is nothing to pick and nothing to generate. The overview still happens, only without slides.
strings.這場不做簡報。要改回來就把上面的勾取消。: No deck for this visit. Untick the box above to change that back.
strings.一個區塊一個勾，整區一起進去——不必逐頁挑。「只選這區」會清掉其他區塊；必選頁（: One tick per block and the whole block goes in — no need to pick page by page. "Only this block" clears the others; the mandatory slides (cover, programme, contents, the claim, thank you) always stay and are locked here. Your ticks save themselves
strings.這裡列的是母簡報的區塊，先看先勾都可以；但要記得住、產得出 .pptx，得先到「: These are the blocks of the master deck; look and tick whenever you like. For them to be remembered, and for a .pptx to come out, fill in a visit on the Before tab first (an organisation name is enough to create one).
strings.從母簡報挑出勾選的那幾頁，改好第 1–3 頁與第二語言，直接下載 .pptx。: Takes the ticked slides out of the master deck, rewrites slides 1–3 and the second language, and downloads the .pptx.
strings.這一頁：來賓離開後四件事: This tab: four things once the visitors leave
strings.——簽名簿、名片、三十秒口述、當天資料。這些東西直接決定訪後信寄得到誰、寫得出什: — the signing book, business cards, a thirty-second dictation, the material from the day. These decide who the thank-you letter can reach and what it can say, so doing them on the day costs the least; by the next day the memory has gone.
strings.來賓離開後這幾件事，幾分鐘做完。受訪的是主持人自己。: A few minutes' work once the visitors have left. The person being asked is the host.
strings.參訪的結束時間一到，系統會寄一封提醒: when the visit's finishing time passes, the system emails a reminder
strings.到中心信箱（還缺哪幾件、附一個直接打開這一頁的連結）。收件信箱在「設定」分頁。: to the centre's inbox — what is still missing, with a link that opens this tab. The address is on the Settings tab.
strings.來賓專頁的三個連結: Three links to the guest page
strings.都是這一場的專屬頁面，差別只在打開後停在哪一段。: All three open this visit's own page; they differ only in where the page opens.
strings.動作一｜拍一張簽名簿: Step one | Photograph the signing book
strings.實體本子拍一張就好。AI 把手寫字讀成一則一則留言，讀錯直接改——原圖會一直留著: One photo of the book is enough. The AI reads the handwriting into separate messages; correct anything it gets wrong — the photo is kept, so you can always check it again.
strings.AI 讀到的留言（可修改；署名看不清就留空）: What the AI read (editable; leave the name blank if it cannot be made out)
strings.整頁的字（AI 讀出來的原文）: The whole page as read (the AI's raw text)
strings.現場拿到名片就拍一張（手機會直接開相機，可以連拍幾張）。AI 讀成姓名、職稱、單: Photograph each card as you are given it (on a phone this opens the camera, and you can take several in a row). The AI reads out the name, title, organisation, email and phone,
strings.你確認後: and only once you have checked it
strings.才併進這場的名單——訪後信就會寄給他。原圖留著，讀錯可以回頭核對。: does the person join this visit's list — so the thank-you letter reaches them. The photo is kept, so anything misread can be checked again.
strings.今天誰來、最想看哪一間、問了什麼、有沒有透露合作意願。: Who came today, which laboratory they most wanted to see, what they asked, whether they hinted at working together.
strings.逐字稿（沒錄音也可以直接打字，再按「抽取」）: Transcript (with no recording, type it here and press "Extract")
strings.最想看哪幾間（逗號分隔房號）: Most wanted to see (room numbers, comma separated)
strings.確認並存入回饋: Confirm and save to the responses
strings.動作四｜當天資料放上專屬頁面: Step four | Put the day's material on the guest page
strings.感謝信只會承諾頁面上真的有的東西。先把簡報 PDF、合照、相關連結放上來，再草擬: The thank-you letter only promises what is really on the page. Put the deck PDF, the photos and any links up first, then draft the letter. The page:
strings.簡報 PDF（從 PowerPoint 另存；4.5 MB 以內直接上傳，更大的: Deck PDF (save it from PowerPoint; up to 4.5 MB uploads directly, anything larger goes in as a cloud link)
strings.現場合照（可多張，會自動縮到長邊 1600px）: Photos from the day (several are fine; they are resized to 1600px on the long edge)
strings.現在該寄這一封: This is the one to send now
strings.跟對方確認日期時間，順便把來賓專頁網址交出去——當天他們掃 QR 打開的就是那一: Confirms the date and time, and hands over the guest page address — that is the page their QR code opens on the day.
strings.用自己的信箱寄（mailto）: Send from your own mail app (mailto)
strings.附上當天資料，並請他們回三個問題。: Attaches the material from the day and asks them three questions.
strings.三個回應項目的措辭固定為請益語氣，且回覆頁支援真匿名；請保留信裡的那一段。: The three questions are always phrased as asking for advice, and the reply page takes a genuinely anonymous answer; please keep that part of the letter.
strings.寄出之後就不必再回來按什麼了：來賓的回覆會自己進「資料」分頁，: Once it has gone out there is nothing to come back and press: the replies land on the Records tab by themselves,
strings.一頁摘要每天凌晨自己產: the one-page summary is written overnight
strings.（回覆陸續進來就自己重寫一份），Drive 備份也是自動的。: (and rewritten as more replies come in), and the Drive backup is automatic too.
strings.這一頁：歷次參訪的檔案: This tab: the archive of past visits
strings.——每場的一頁摘要、來賓回覆、現場動線，以及跨場次的彙整。年報與諮詢委員會要的數: — each visit's one-page summary, the guests' replies, the route on the day, and what recurs across visits. The numbers the annual report and the advisory board ask for (people, roles, countries, which laboratory draws the most attention) come from here.
strings.點一個國家，看那幾場: click a country to see those visits
strings.點一列看那一場的摘要、回覆與動線: click a row for that visit's summary, replies and route
strings.現場動線（沒有訊號的時段用行程推補）: Route on the day (stretches with no signal are filled in from the programme)
strings.跨場次彙整：開放建議裡重複出現的問題: Across visits: what the open suggestions keep saying
strings.這一頁：一次做完就不用再碰的東西: This tab: things you set up once and never touch again
strings.——母簡報、現場動線的捷徑與貼紙、預設值，以及「哪些外部服務接好了」。這些不屬於: — the master deck, the shortcuts and NFC stickers for the route, the defaults, and which external services are connected. None of it belongs to a particular visit, which is why it is not on the tabs before this one.
strings.站台存一份，之後每場產簡報就不必再選檔。可以直接選原始的母簡報（含影片、幾百 M: Keep one copy on the site and you never have to pick a file again. You can choose the original master deck (videos, hundreds of MB, all fine) — it is slimmed down in the browser before it goes up.
strings.捷徑與 NFC 貼紙，一次做完之後每場自動記: shortcuts and NFC stickers; set up once, recorded by itself from then on
strings.來賓走到哪一間、待多久，靠兩種訊號記下來：: Which laboratory the visitors are in, and for how long, is recorded by two kinds of signal:
strings.老師開簡報的捷徑: a shortcut the teacher opens the slides with
strings.（電腦桌面，點了先送訊號再開簡報）與: (on the desktop: it sends the signal, then opens the deck) and
strings.門口的 NFC 貼紙: an NFC sticker by the door
strings.（主持人碰一下手機）。沒有訊號的時段用當天的行程推補。訊號不必帶參訪代碼——伺服: (the host taps a phone against it). Stretches with no signal are filled in from that day's programme. A signal does not need the visit code — the server matches it to the visit scheduled for today.
strings.iPhone 的 NFC 貼紙怎麼設（一次）: Setting up the NFC stickers on an iPhone (once)
strings.簡報室與五間研究室門口各貼一片 NFC 貼紙（NTAG213 就夠）。: One NFC tag by the door of the briefing room and each of the five laboratories (NTAG213 is enough).
strings.iPhone「捷徑」App → 自動化 → 新增 → NFC → 掃描那片貼紙、: In the iPhone Shortcuts app: Automation → New → NFC → scan the tag, name it (Lab 303, say) → turn off "Ask Before Running".
strings.動作選「取得 URL 內容」，網址貼上面那一行的 NFC 網址，方法 GET。: Choose the action "Get Contents of URL", paste the NFC address from the line above, method GET.
strings.不要加任何顯示動作——碰一下就送出，螢幕不用亮。: Do not add anything that displays a result — a tap sends it, the screen never has to light up.
strings.研究生代按或來賓自己按也可以：來賓端專頁最下面有「我現在在哪一間」，那個不需要金: A student, or a guest, can press it instead: the bottom of the guest page has "which room am I in now", and that needs no key.
strings.訪後信預設寄件者: Default sender of the thank-you letter
strings.（依今日流程），系統會寄一封收工提醒到上面那個信箱——手機收信就會跳出來。一場只: (from that day's programme), the system emails a wrap-up reminder to the address above — it arrives on your phone like any other mail. Once per visit, and not at all once all four things are done. Gmail has to be connected.
strings.金鑰一律放 Netlify 的環境變數，這裡只看得到「接好了沒」。改完要重新部署: Keys live in Netlify's environment variables; all that shows here is whether something is connected. Changes take effect after a redeploy.
strings.來賓專頁上那五張卡片（一句話研究主題、專長、學經歷、照片）目前放在 repo 的: The five cards on the guest page (one-line research topic, expertise, background, photo) currently live in the repository at
strings.，還不能在後台改——內容要先經各位老師確認（CLAUDE.md 待確認 1）。確: and cannot be edited here yet — the wording has to be confirmed by each teacher first (CLAUDE.md, open question 1). Send me the confirmed text and I will put it in.
strings.把 ADMIN_TOKEN 換成這台裝置的登入憑證，之後半年不必再貼: Exchanges ADMIN_TOKEN for a sign-in on this device; you will not have to paste it again for six months
strings.切換介面語言 · Switch interface language: 切換介面語言 · Switch interface language
strings.清掉這台裝置的登入憑證（共用電腦用完請按）: Clears the sign-in on this device (press it when you have finished on a shared computer)
strings.把這一份還沒存成一場的草稿清掉，表單回到空白: Throws away this unsaved draft and empties the form
strings.整場刪掉：來賓專頁跟著消失。已經有人回覆或已寄出感謝信的不給刪；Drive 備份: Deletes the whole visit; the guest page goes with it. A visit with replies, or whose thank-you letter has been sent, cannot be deleted; the Drive backup is left alone
strings.把 email 往來（含轉寄、簽名檔）整段貼進來……（也可以只上傳名單檔）: Paste the whole email thread here, forwards and signatures included… (or just upload a list)
strings.把貼上的信與附件交給 AI，讀出單位、名單、日期、目的，填進下面的欄位給你改: Hands the pasted email and any files to the AI, which reads out the organisation, the list, the date and the purpose and fills in the fields below for you to correct
strings.手動補一個人（名單上每個人都要 email，訪後信才寄得到）: Add someone by hand (everyone needs an email for the thank-you letter to reach them)
strings.查這個單位與名單上的人的公開資料，判斷他們可能為什麼來、可能最想看哪幾間: Looks up public information about the organisation and the people on the list, and works out why they are probably coming and which laboratories they would most want to see
strings.依人數、時間、興趣排出今日流程與現場動線: Builds the programme and the route from the headcount, the time available and their interests
strings.自己加一個流程區塊（AI 排的不合就直接改）: Add a block yourself (change whatever the AI got wrong)
strings.複製來賓專頁網址，貼到信裡或 LINE 給對方: Copies the guest page address, to paste into a letter or a message
strings.把這一場加進行事曆，結束時間跳出來提醒你拍簽名簿、講三十秒口述。系統本來就會在那: Puts this visit in your calendar, with a reminder at the finishing time to photograph the signing book and record the dictation. The system emails that reminder anyway; this is for anyone who wants it in the calendar too
strings.到「資料」分頁看全部歷次參訪、來賓回覆、動線與一頁摘要: Opens the Records tab: every past visit, the replies, the routes and the summaries
strings.把母簡報的每一個區塊都選上（很少這樣做，時間不夠）: Ticks every block of the master deck (rarely right — there is never enough time)
strings.清掉所有勾選，只留封面、流程、架構、核心宣稱、謝謝這幾頁: Clears every tick, leaving the cover, the programme, the contents, the claim and the thank-you slide
strings.用這一場的行程與勾選的頁次，從母簡報做出這一場專屬的 .pptx 並下載: Builds this visit's own .pptx out of the master deck, from its programme and the ticked slides, and downloads it
strings.把簽名簿照片存起來，並讓 AI 把手寫字讀成一則一則留言: Saves the photo of the signing book and has the AI read the handwriting into separate messages
strings.AI 漏掉的留言自己加一則: Add a message the AI missed
strings.把上面這些留言寫進這一場的回饋紀錄（之後的摘要與彙整會讀到）: Writes the messages above into this visit's responses (the summary and the cross-visit digest read them)
strings.把勾選的人併進這一場的名單——訪後信就會寄給他們: Merges the ticked people into this visit's list, so the thank-you letter reaches them
strings.錄下你自己的三十秒口述：誰來、最想看哪一間、問了什麼、有沒有合作意願: Record your own thirty seconds: who came, which laboratory they most wanted to see, what they asked, whether they want to work together
strings.把音檔存起來，轉成文字並抽出上面那幾項: Saves the recording, turns it into text and pulls out those few things
strings.沒錄音也可以：把打好的逐字稿交給 AI 抽出那幾項: No recording needed: hand the typed transcript to the AI and it pulls out the same things
strings.把口述抽出來的內容寫進這一場的回饋紀錄: Writes what the dictation gave into this visit's responses
strings.或貼 Drive／OneDrive 連結 https://…: or paste a Drive/OneDrive link https://…
strings.PDF 超過 4.5 MB 時改貼雲端連結，來賓專頁就放這個連結: For a PDF over 4.5 MB paste a cloud link instead; the guest page will use that link
strings.多加一筆要給來賓的連結（論文、雲端資料夾、影片）: Add another link for the guests (a paper, a cloud folder, a video)
strings.把上面這些連結放上來賓專頁——感謝信只會承諾頁面上真的有的東西: Puts these links on the guest page — the thank-you letter only promises what is really there
strings.重讀收件人清單（名單上每個人 ＋ 當天在專頁留信箱的人）: Reloads the recipients (everyone on the list plus anyone who left an email on the page)
strings.確認信的署名：通常是對口老師: Who the confirmation letter is signed by: usually the host teacher
strings.草擬一封給對方的確認信：確認日期時間、附上來賓專頁網址: Drafts a confirmation letter: the date and time, with the guest page address
strings.確認信草稿會出現在這裡: The draft confirmation letter appears here
strings.把確認信寄給上面勾選的人（用中心的 Gmail）。沒設定 Gmail 時會給你: Sends the confirmation letter to the people ticked above, from the centre's Gmail. Without Gmail set up you get a mailto link to send it yourself
strings.複製主旨與內文，貼到你自己的信箱寄出: Copies the subject and the body, to send from your own mail
strings.感謝信的署名: Who the thank-you letter is signed by
strings.草擬感謝信：附上當天資料，並把三個回應項目的連結放進去: Drafts the thank-you letter: the material from the day, with a link to the three questions

strings.把歷次「開放建議」一起讀過，找出重複出現的問題（例如某一間反覆被說聽不懂）: Reads every open suggestion together and finds what keeps coming up (one laboratory repeatedly called hard to follow, say)
